title: Just eh for me
text: Just eh for me. My house has more lazy Susans in it than I like to admit, in fact I kind of hate them. We have two in on cabinet that we were making for snacks, so I thought these would be a really great way to keep different kinds of snacks separated and organized. I don't like they don't actually nest up against each other fully, they kind of sit at a weird angle so you lose space when you use these. You can really only put smaller items in these. They should have fit in my cabinet no problem, but they were like a half inch to long so they didn't nest into the lip and instead rested on it, so it really just didn't work for my space at all. It is well built, the thickness of the plastic makes me think they would hold up pretty well even with high usage.
